name: E2E SuperOffice - Tickets
description: Get Record, Update Record and Find Records on a ticket the flow creates (closed with a status of the tenant, owner set), Create Task and Create Note linked to the ticket and assigned to a user; everything is deleted at the end.

## Test data

Needs SuperOffice Service on the tenant. The connector has no component that creates a ticket, so Make API Call creates and deletes it. Status 3 is **Closed** in a standard tenant.
